description: Compacting types the documented /compact command while Claude is idle; nothing confirms it inside a verify window, so the result is typed. (Model and effort changes restart the session instead, since /model and /effort change Claude's default for every session.) Harness deviation: a fake `claude` on PATH prints version 2.1.319 and idles; the claude adapter's transcript feed reads testdata/claude/transcript-basic.jsonl, and the anchor marker reports epoch "e1" with fixed offsets.
